title: Green Recipe Book
description: Colorize the Recipe Book! The icon is green, so why is the book gray?
body:
Greetings!
This Resource Pack adds a little bit of color to the Recipe Book. ``` [MIT] Please feel free to use it in any way you wish! ``` ![recipe book](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f238a24c364a87989aa73f7d3fc42545da964ee.png)
![compat & recommendation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb4f1a8f6ef19d3fde0ffbedf2648d0913556913.png) It also pairs well with the [Better Recipe Book](https://modrinth.com/mod/brb) mod 1.20-1.21.1.
Quick summary of features: - Pin recipes for easy crafting ![pin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b13d180b5ffb99f1c42bc5e0a448ccaf4fc8bfb.png) - Scroll through the pages of the book. MAJOR quality of life improvement! - Instant crafting. Crafts a recipe instantly upon selection (if you've got the ingredients)
Disabled ![instant crafting disabled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69220ea9907f98f7c1a3188b5cd8db5797e43391.png)
Enabled ![Enabled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3da6ef32d42a2ebca9a332d0207b479a40e11386.png) - Option to unlock all recipes -- enabled by default. Personally, I disable it. - Settings screen to configure all options listed above ![settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/992d2a345afd71886921a9acb93a2d948174d61a.png) ![brb compat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/87a9f3f5a8f79a30cbdcbb6a07c4d70ca99b3c01.png) (Buttons & GUI features retextured to match the style of this pack) ![gem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8dcbbb02123519ca995198ea5befa002d4844143.png) :D
